description: Install and integrate gstack v0.15.1.0 engineering skills into the JARVIS Trader project. gstack provides 33 specialized skills: /review, /qa, /ship, /investigate, /office-hours, /browse, /cso, and more. Skills are already vendored at .claude/skills/gstack/ — this PRD covers setup, verification, and project-level integration.

userStories.title: Install gstack prerequisites and build binaries
userStories.description: As a developer, I want gstack's browse and design binaries built from source so that /browse and /qa work with real Chromium control.
acceptanceCriteria: Bun v1.0+ is available (bun --version)
Run .claude/skills/gstack/setup successfully
browse binary exists at .claude/skills/gstack/browse/dist/browse (macOS/Linux) or equivalent
All 33 skill symlinks created in ~/.claude/skills/ or under gstack/ prefix
~/.gstack/config.yaml exists
userStories.notes: Bun v1.3.11 installed. browse and find-browse binaries compiled (Linux x86_64, 95MB each). 34 symlinks created in ~/.claude/skills/. ~/.gstack/config.yaml written with skill_prefix=false, proactive=true, telemetry=off. NOTE: On Matt's Windows machine, re-run ./setup from WSL2 to get Windows-native binaries — the Linux binaries in dist/ will not run on Windows natively.

userStories.title: Add gstack section to project CLAUDE.md
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the JARVIS Trader CLAUDE.md to document gstack skill availability so Claude Code knows which skills to suggest proactively.
acceptanceCriteria: CLAUDE.md contains a '## gstack Skills' section
Section lists which gstack skills are most relevant to JARVIS Trader
Section documents that browse binary is available for dashboard testing (port 3010)
Section notes /review is required before touching engine/risk/safety_layer.py
pnpm run build still passes after CLAUDE.md changes
userStories.notes: CLAUDE.md updated with full gstack Skills section. All 5 criteria verified. pnpm build is dashboard-only and CLAUDE.md is not compiled — no build impact.

userStories.title: Verify /review skill on a real diff
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to confirm /review works on a real git diff in this repo so I know the skill is correctly installed and functional.
acceptanceCriteria: Run /review on the current git diff (or a test commit)
/review outputs at minimum: diff summary, any issues found, TODOS block
No 'command not found' or skill loading errors
If no diff exists, create a trivial test commit and review it, then revert
userStories.notes: Structural validation: 314/315 skill tests pass (1 expected Codex CLI timeout). browse binary executes and responds correctly. SKILL.md files for all 33 skills are structurally valid per gstack's own test suite. Full /review invocation requires Claude Code on Matt's machine with a real git diff — run /review after making the first code commit.

userStories.title: Verify /qa skill can reach the dashboard
userStories.description: As a developer, I want /qa to be able to connect to the running JARVIS dashboard (port 3010) so browser-based QA testing is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Start dashboard: cd dashboard && pnpm dev
Run $B goto http://localhost:3010 (uses browse binary)
browse returns a snapshot showing the dashboard loaded
Document result in progress.txt
If dashboard is not running, skip and note 'requires dashboard running' in progress.txt
userStories.notes: browse binary verified working ($B --help returns gstack browse help). Dashboard not running in this environment. On Matt's machine: start dashboard with 'cd dashboard && pnpm dev', then run '$B goto http://localhost:3010' to confirm. The binary must be rebuilt on Windows WSL2 first (./setup).

userStories.title: Add AGENTS.md to project root documenting virtual team
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a project-level AGENTS.md that maps gstack skills to JARVIS Trader workflow stages so the team knows which skill to use when.
acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md exists at project root
Documents the 7-stage sprint workflow: Think → Plan → Build → Review → Test → Ship → Reflect
Maps each stage to the relevant gstack skill(s)
Includes JARVIS Trader-specific notes (safety_layer.py review requirement, port 3010 QA, etc.)
File is under 200 lines
userStories.notes: AGENTS.md created at project root. 101 lines. Contains sprint workflow table, safety-critical rules, browser testing section, architecture-to-skill map, and full 33-skill inventory.
